'''Champion's armor''' is an armor set that can be found within various {{MCD|mission}}s. Its unique variant is the {{MCD|hero's armor}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Missions ===

''<small>Listed difficulties are considered to be the minimum difficulty, the item is obtainable on unless stated otherwise.</small>''

''<small>A {{DuMiscSprite|Daily Trial}} before a mission name indicates that the item is only obtainable in [[MCD:Daily Trial|Daily Trials]] of that mission.</small>''

* {{DuLevelLink|Arch Haven}} (Apocalypse)
* {{DuLevelLink|Cacti Canyon}} (Apocalypse)
* {{DuLevelLink|Lone Fortress}} (Apocalypse, DLC)
* {{DuMiscSprite|Daily Trial}} {{DuLevelLink|Abyssal Monument}}  (DLC)
* {{DuLevelLink|Tower}}

=== Merchants ===

* {{DuEntityLink|Village Merchant}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Gift Wrapper}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Mystery Merchant}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Luxury Merchant}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Piglin Merchant}}

=== Ancients ===

* {{DuEntityLink|Ancient Terror}}

== Usage ==
=== Properties ===
* +X health
* 35% damage reduction
* Mobs target you more
* -40% [[MCD:Health Potion|potion]] cooldown
